story.value: Radon was discovered in 1900 by Friedrich Ernst Dorn, a German chemist, while he was studying radium's decay chain.
The name radon was derived from radium.

uses.value: Hospitals sometimes use radon to treat some forms of cancer.
A few hospitals still produce radon for therapeutic use.
